name: Gadget Quick Use
author: ParadoxEpoch
description: Use the Swingshot, Trespasser, and Hydrodisplacer without equipping them first, like in later Ratchet & Clank games.

settings.name: Use button (Trespasser & Hydrodisplacer)
settings.description: Which button uses the gadget on a Trespasser pad or Hydrodisplacer faucet. Triangle leaves Circle for a weapon or gadget you equipped yourself and is the RaC2 style. Both is similar to Triangle, but also accepts Circle. The Swingshot ignores this setting, it always uses Circle.

settings.name: Skip Hydrodisplacer camera
settings.description: Skip the scripted camera after the Hydrodisplacer attaches. The tank still fills or empties.

settings.name: Swingshot quick-use
settings.description: Attach to a Swingshot versatarget without equipping it first. The previous weapon comes back when the swing ends.
